summary: Beneficient filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Beneficient Financing, L.L.C. and guarantor Beneficient Company Holdings, L.P. amended a March 10, 2026 letter agreement with affiliate lender HH-BDH, LLC. The amendment, effective October 7, 2026, extends the deadline for a $1,000,000 cash payment of remaining interest and fees under the October 19, 2023 Credit and Guaranty Agreement from five business days after September 30, 2026 to March 31, 2027. HH-BDH's sole member, Hicks Holdings Operating, LLC, is managed by director Mack Hicks, a related-party transaction. No change of control, tender, or strategic event; routine credit-amendment disclosure. Watch for further extensions or defaults.
